scout_postings.sql:
SELECT *
FROM scout_postings
WHERE LOWER(TRIM(location_city)) = 'columbus'
  AND LOWER(TRIM(location_state)) IN ('oh', 'ohio')
  AND (
    LOWER(COALESCE(title, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(description, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(category, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%finance%'
    OR LOWER(COALESCE(title, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(description, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(category, '') || ' ' || COALESCE(skills_json, '')) LIKE '%financial%'
  )
scout_postings.title: Finance jobs in Columbus, Ohio

querychat_viz_widgets.ggsql:
SELECT location_state, COUNT(*) AS job_count
FROM scout_postings
WHERE active = 1
  AND location_state IS NOT NULL
  AND TRIM(location_state) <> ''
GROUP BY location_state
ORDER BY job_count DESC
VISUALISE location_state AS y, job_count AS x
DRAW bar
PROJECT y, x TO cartesian
LABEL x => 'Active job postings', y => 'US state'
